facts.fact: Biometric Update reports hundreds of thousands of Cameroon's printed national ID cards have been abandoned at police stations.
Biometric Update reports the National Identification Authority said more than 600,000 printed Ghana Cards had been uncollected at regional and district offices since 2018.
Biometric Update reports The Gambia's new national identity system has instant issuance, producing the GAM ID card in real time after biometric enrolment.
Kenya's Principal Secretary for Immigration said in early November 2026 that more than 550,000 printed national ID cards remained uncollected.
Biometric Update reports Sierra Leone's National Civil Registration Authority has announced that abandoned ID cards should be picked up.
Biometric Update reports NIDA said in September 2026 that about 2.02 million printed national ID cards were awaiting collection.
Biometric Update reports Uganda said 10 million of 15.4 million printed national ID cards had been picked up, with 35 percent uncollected.
